ledger: Silver dotted-rim coin on green felt, right of the cups (00:00.000-00:02.750): the only text element large/sharp enough to attempt a reading. 00:00.000-00:01.000: single embossed word, blurry, reads roughly 'PREMIUM'/'PRESENT'-like but not resolvable to a real word. 00:02.250: same coin, inscription now looks like a Devanagari-style glyph run with a head-bar, not a Latin word. 00:02.750 (sharpest frame): reads as block Latin letters approx 'NOYKY'/'NOVEY', a non-word.
Gold coin on felt between cups and silver coin (00:00.000-00:02.750): faint embossed script approx 'Jiresse'/'Texas'-like, too small and low-contrast to read reliably; not judged.
Gold coin at bottom of felt (00:00.000-00:02.750): partially in frame, embossed inscription smeared ('WRONG?'-like strokes at 00:02.750), too blurry to read; not judged.

Top coin of stack inside centre cup (00:00.000-00:02.750): large stylised emblem with letter-like strokes ('Ж'/'SIA'-like); the stack is handled and coins are added/removed, so face changes are explained by action; treated as decorative emblem, not text.

Gold coins inset in red table border, left side (00:00.000-00:02.000): cursive pseudo-script ('Texas'/'Nexa'-like) in decorative engraving; small, angled and blurred; stylised lettering not judged as gibberish.

Wide shots 00:03.000-00:09.750: camera pulls back, all coin/chip faces become too small and blurred to read; no signage, screens or other text visible in room (framed pictures on wall contain imagery only).
